{{Quote|Many hundreds of seasons ago, there was a great war between Ewoks and Duloks. The Duloks had come to destroy that which is most precious to our tribe: our Soul Trees. But Erpham Warrick devised this machine, which led the Ewoks to victory! The Soul Trees were saved, and the Duloks were driven into the swamps.|[[Kaink/Legends|Kaink]]|<ref name="WW">{{Ewoks|Wicket's Wagon}}.</ref>}}
The '''Ewok–Dulok wars''' were fought between the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribe that lived in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] and the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] that lived in the [[Dulok Swamp]]. The conflict lasted for generations, during which the Duloks made numerous attempts to destroy areas held sacred by the Ewoks. In two battles, the [[Ewok battle wagon]] played an integral role. [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and his friends foiled several Dulok war strategies in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==History==
===First Battle of the Soul Trees===
{{Quote|We Duloks were all set to take over the forest when they brought out that cursed wagon and knocked us clear back into the swamps. How I'd love to get my hands on that thing! I'd teach those Ewoks a lesson!|[[Murgoob]]|<ref name="WW" />}}
{{Main|First battle of the Soul Trees}}
In one important confrontation, an army of Duloks attempted to cut down the Ewoks' [[Soul Tree]]s with stone axes. The Ewok [[Erpham Warrick]] fought back with the [[Ewok battle wagon]], a war machine he had constructed, and forced the invaders back to their swamps.<ref name="WW" />

===Battle of the Tree of Light===
{{Quote|Soon we'll be rid of this wretched weed, and the Night Spirit will rule Endor!|King [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]]|<ref name="TTOL">{{Ewoks|The Tree of Light}}.</ref>}}
Long after Erpham Warrick had died and the Dulok tribe had come under the rule of King [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], another battle occurred at the Ewoks' sacred [[Tree of Light]]. The Ewoks believed the tree to be weakening and in need of renewal. As a team of young Ewoks traveled to perform the necessary rituals, Gorneesh and his warriors attempted to fell the weakened tree. The rival factions clashed at the tree, and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] turned the tide in the Ewoks' favor.<ref name="TTOL" />

===Second Battle of the Soul Trees===
{{Quote|We've got the machine! We've got the muscle! And soon, the Ewoks will be just a furry little memory.|[[Umwak]]|<ref name="WW" />}}
{{Main|Second battle of the Soul Trees}}
Wicket W. Warrick, grandson of Erpham Warrick, reconstructed his ancestor's battle wagon in 3 ABY, but it fell into the hands of Gorneesh's Duloks. Under guidance of their oracle, [[Murgoob]], the Duloks aimed the contraption at the Ewoks' Soul Trees. Warrick and another Ewok named [[Malani]] managed to sabotage the war machine before it could reach its target and cause any real damage.<ref name="WW" />

===Fish carving affair===
The Duloks fought back some time later with a river-going battleship. They stole a sacred fish carving from the Bright Tree Ewoks and kidnapped several young Ewoks for use as galley slaves. Before they could attack their rivals, however, the Dulok prisoners managed to escape and reclaim the carving.<ref name="PB">{{Ewoks|Prow Beaten}}</ref>

===Battle to free captured Woklings===
After a tribe of Duloks kidnapped Woklings from Bright Tree Village in order to eat them, Ewoks from the village later ambushed the Dulok tribe in a meadow in order to free the Woklings, resulting in a large battle in which multiple Duloks were slain. Because they were fighting so close to the cage containing the captured Woklings, the Ewoks did not use bows or ranged weapons in the battle, instead only gihting with spears, swords, and other handheld weapons. Chirpa led the Ewok warriros into battle, and the Ewoks successfully defeated the Duloks and freed the woklings, with the few Duloks who survived the battle fleeing into the nearby woods.<ref name="TAOT">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref>

===Chirpa-Gorneesh peace summit===
{{Quote|Ho, King Gorneesh! We are here to speak of peace!''"<br />"''Cross over, Chirpa, and we'll talk!|Gorneesh prepares to spring his trap on Chirpa|<ref name="E10">[[Ewoks (1985) 10|''Ewoks'' (1985) 10]]</ref>}}
Eventually, Gorneesh offered a peace treaty to Chief [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], the Ewok leader.<ref name="D4">[[Droids (1986) 4|''Droids'' (1986) 4]]</ref> The two agreed to hold a [[Chirpa–Gorneesh peace summit|peace summit]], but at the agreed upon place, Gorneesh revealed his true intentions when his warriors tried to cut the ropes holding up the bridge Chirpa and his representatives were crossing. The summit a failure, the war continued.<ref name="E10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ewok–Dulok wars were first named in the character profile of Chief Chirpa, as drawn and written by [[Zack Giallongo]] for the release of ''[[Star Wars: Ewoks—Shadows of Endor]]'' in [[2013]].<ref name="profiles">{{WebCite|url=http://www.cbr.com/exclusive-giallongo-introduces-the-ewoks-of-shadows-of-endor|text=EXCLUSIVE: Giallongo Introduces the Ewoks of "Shadows of Endor"|work=Comic Book Resources|archivedate=20170922000536}}</ref>
